defect: vfpu_sin, vfpu_cos and vfpu_sincos reduce the angle with angle -= floorf(angle*4)*0.25f, i.e. modulo 0.25 instead of modulo the period 4, so the results are wrong for almost all inputs.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added lines with floorf(angle*0.25f)*4.f; the wrong range reduction is in code this change introduced and is evident from the arithmetic.

defect: The new ShowLeaderboardSubmitted shows its message as OSDType::MESSAGE_SUCCESS instead of the LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED type this change added, so leaderboard-submitted popups are not treated as leaderboard events (not cleared by ClearAchievementStuff, later not placed per the notification-position setting).
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to LEADERBOARD_SUBMITTED; the mismatch with the new enum value listed in ClearAchievementStuff is visible in the diff.

defect: A function-local static const array stores pointers to categoryToggles_ of the first ControlMappingScreen instance, so later screens use dangling pointers into a destroyed object (use-after-free).
reason: The fix drops the pointer member from the static table and takes &categoryToggles_[curCat] each time; the statically initialised member pointers are visible in the diff.

defect: In the indexed texture-preview path the change unconditionally binds texPreviewVao, ibuf and vbuf and sets the attribute pointer to offset 0 even when VAOs are unsupported (all three are 0), so the non-VAO path reads vertices through a null pointer.
reason: The fix moves these debug-leftover calls into the texPreviewVao != 0 branch; the unconditional calls are visible in the diff.

defect: The re-added mouse coordinate factor of 2 is applied whenever iWindowWidth < 560 and not fullscreen, including when the window is maximized from 1x size, so mouse and touch coordinates are doubled and wrong.
reason: Just before this change there was no factor at all; the fix adds !IsZoomed to this added line, and seeing the bug needs knowing that iWindowWidth is not updated on maximize.

defect: The new ImMemView header and source, added to the CMake and VS builds, do not compile or link: for example redraw() is declared and called but never defined and the .cpp still uses Win32 member signatures.
reason: The commit itself says it is not yet building and the fix 'Fix memview build' repairs it, dropping the undefined redraw() declaration; seeing the failure needs ImMemView.cpp.

defect: The new #ifdef __GLIBC__ guard sends every non-glibc platform, including Qt/Symbian, to the #else branch that uses the global timezone variable, which does not work there, breaking the Symbian build of the local/UTC tick conversions.
reason: Before the change the tm_gmtoff code was unconditional; the fix only widens this added guard to __SYMBIAN32__, and the failure depends on the Symbian C library.

defect: The change stores the GL/WGL/EGL extension strings into std::string members of GLExtensions, which CheckGLExtensions memsets to zero (undefined behaviour on std::string), and assigning a null char pointer to them crashes.
reason: The fix moves the strings to separate globals and null-checks the C strings; seeing that the members are std::string needs gl_state.h.

defect: In UpdateRenderResolution the new portrait and landscape branches are swapped: portrait gets a 480x272 render size and landscape 272x480.
reason: The fix swaps exactly these added branches; the inversion is visible against the other portrait branches in the same diff.

defect: __UsbGpsDoState is inserted in the middle of the HLE Modules savestate section with a section whose minimum version is 1, so savestates made before this change fail to load.
reason: The fix moves the call to the end with a note to add new sections last; the breakage depends on the PointerWrap section rules and Section(1, 4) in sceUsbGps.cpp.

defect: The Back button of the new InstallZipScreen finishes the dialog via OnBack, which EmuScreen does not handle for this dialog, leaving a black screen.
reason: The fix changes this added line to OnOK so that EmuScreen handles it; the effect depends on EmuScreen's dialog-finished handling.

defect: Step_TcFloatThrough stops halving through-mode float UVs while the VertexReader's new isThrough() check relies on an uninitialised vtype_, so through-mode float texture coordinates end up wrongly scaled.
reason: The fix restores the *0.5f in exactly these lines and later commits keep halving in the decoder and doubling in the reader; seeing it needs VertexDecoder.h and the transform pipeline.

defect: The added UIContext::BeginFrame() call sits before the EmuScreen_NoFrame BindFramebufferAsRenderTarget, which then discards the UI state BeginFrame set up, breaking the UI drawn on frames without a present such as after a crash.
reason: The fix moves this added call after the framebuffer bind; why the order matters needs the draw and UIContext code.

defect: scePsmfPlayerCreate no longer creates the player: it returns ERROR_PSMF_NOT_FOUND when the player does not exist yet, so Create never succeeds and later calls run without a player (Start then dereferences a null psmfplayer).
reason: The fix restores creating the PsmfPlayer in exactly these lines; a create function that fails when the object is absent is visible in the diff.

defect: The new menu handling uses ID_CHEAT, which is not defined in resource.h, so the Windows build fails.
reason: The fix renames it to ID_EMULATION_CHEATS and adds that ID to resource.h and ppsspp.rc; seeing the missing define needs resource.h.

defect: stepVideo now calls updateSwsFormat before any null checks, and updateSwsFormat dereferences m_pCodecCtx, crashing when the media context was never opened.
reason: Before the change stepVideo returned early on null frames; the fix guards this added updateSwsFormat with m_pCodecCtx != 0 and adds null checks to stepVideo.

defect: For non-through mode the change doubles the UV offsets (uvscaleoff[2] and [3]) along with the scales, although only the scale should compensate for the halved texcoords, so texture coordinates are shifted.
reason: The fix, titled as fixing the UV error of the previous commit, removes exactly the two added offset lines; seeing it needs the shader formula a_texcoord * scale + offset.

defect: Rewriting the guard as !(MOBILE_DEVICE || _DEBUG) inverts the _DEBUG case, so desktop debug builds get no file, console or ring log listeners while the destructor still removes and deletes them.
reason: The fix restores !defined(MOBILE_DEVICE) || defined(_DEBUG) on these lines; the inversion is visible against the unchanged destructor guard.

defect: In the new mirroring loop b is read from line[x*3+1] instead of line[x*3+2], corrupting the blue channel of mirrored camera images.
reason: The fix corrects exactly this added index; the typo is visible in the diff.

defect: The new k0 block writes the thread UID at the unaligned offset 0xca and the initial stack at 0xc0, instead of the UID at 0xc0 and the stack at 0xc8.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly these added writes; the unaligned 0xca store is visible in the diff.

defect: GetModifTime passes &buf.st_mtime to localtime_r, but on Android stat64::st_mtime is not a time_t, so the Android build fails.
reason: The fix adds a time_t pointer cast to this added call; the type mismatch depends on the Android stat64 definition.

defect: The fix removes the glEnable/glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D) calls this change added; they are fixed-function state with no effect on shader-based texturing (and an invalid enum on GLES2).
reason: Removing ineffective GL calls is cleanup rather than the repair of an observable wrong result; texturing is controlled by the shaders and PSPSetTexture.

defect: The fix removes the change's temporary override that forced key.cullMode to VK_CULL_MODE_NONE, re-enabling culling once rendering was flipped right side up.
reason: The override was a deliberate, labelled debugging workaround in the in-development Vulkan backend while its output was upside down; enabling culling completes the feature rather than repairing a defect.

defect: The new early return on a short ZIM fread in ReplacedTexture::Load leaks the FILE handle, since fp is never closed on that path.
reason: The fix adds fclose(fp) to this added error path; the missing close is visible in the diff.

defect: DoBlockTransfer computes dstBasePtr and dstStride from the transfersrc and transfersrcw registers, so the block copy targets the source instead of the destination.
reason: The fix changes these added lines to transferdst and transferdstw; the copy-paste error is visible in the diff.

defect: CConfig::Save now returns without saving when the existing ini cannot be read, so a missing config file (for example on first run) is never created.
reason: The fix deletes exactly this added return; a careful reviewer can see that Save would refuse to write a new file.

defect: The change moves the CLUT pointer into SamplerID::cached.clut, which only the binner fills, so the debugger's GetCurrentTexture builds a SamplerID with a null clut and the sampler crashes on CLUT textures.
reason: The fix sets id.cached.clut in Rasterizer.cpp and makes the new pointer fields const; the crash is visible only with Rasterizer.cpp and the sampler code.

defect: In the new Comp_Vsgn, XMM0 is zeroed once before the loop but CMPEQSS and ANDNPS overwrite it, so elements after the first are compared against a garbage value instead of 0.0f.
reason: The fix moves the XORPS into the loop; the reuse of the clobbered register is visible in the diff.

defect: In the new rewind path of scePsmfPlayerStart, readSize is set to size - mpegoffset and then immediately overwritten with 0.
reason: The fix deletes the stray readSize = 0 line this change added; the dead assignment is visible in the diff.

defect: The new sceNpAuth_A1DE86F8 and sceNpService_0F8F5821 stubs log themselves as sceNpAuth_4EC1F667 (copy-paste), producing misleading UNIMPL logs.
reason: The fix corrects the function names in these added log lines; a minor but wrong output of code this change added.

defect: lastBufSize_ is computed as (indexR - m_indexW) & mask, with the operands reversed and in different units from the displayed m_maxBufsize, so the debug buffer fill shown is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces this added line with ((indexW - indexR) & mask) / 2; the reversed subtraction is visible against numLeft in the same function.

defect: The new rpTypeDebugNames table contains INPUT variants that RenderPassType no longer has (its bits are DEPTH, MULTIVIEW, MULTISAMPLE and BACKBUFFER), so render passes get the wrong debug names.
reason: At this commit the enum already lacked the INPUT bit and the fix removes the INPUT entries; seeing it needs VulkanFramebuffer.h.

defect: Step() now calls WalkCurve(type_) for every state including STATE_OFF, so a finished envelope keeps being walked with the release curve, changing height_ and causing audio artefacts.
reason: The fix moves WalkCurve back into the active state cases; the hoisted call next to the do-nothing STATE_OFF case is visible in the diff.

defect: ImWatchWindow::Draw passes &cfg.atracToolOpen to ImGui::Begin instead of &cfg.watchOpen, so closing the watch window toggles the Atrac tool flag and the watch window cannot be closed.
reason: The fix changes this added argument to cfg.watchOpen; the copy-paste is visible next to watchOpen in the same diff.

defect: The combo key list's UI name, which is also its translation key, becomes FastForward instead of Fast-forward, the name used for VIRTKEY_FASTFORWARD elsewhere and in the updated translations, so this label is shown untranslated.
reason: The fix changes this added string to Fast-forward; seeing the mismatch needs KeyMap.cpp and the language files, and the defect is minor and cosmetic-functional.

defect: The new early returns for pointers in analogPointerMask make buttons and the dpad ignore every event of that pointer, including TOUCH_UP and TOUCH_RELEASE_ALL, so a control that took the pointer before the overlapping analog stick stays stuck down.
reason: The fix removes these early returns and applies the analog mask only when acquiring on TOUCH_MOVE; the swallowed up and release events are visible in the diff.

defect: The new logicOps lookup table is not in GELogicOp order (for example index 1 maps to GL_SET instead of GL_AND), so most PSP logic ops map to the wrong GL logic op.
reason: The fix reorders exactly this added table; checking the order needs the GELogicOp enum, although the removed if-chain hints at it.

defect: Moving the UMD type constants into the header changed PSP_UMD_TYPE_GAME from 0x10 to 0x00, so the disc info reports the wrong UMD type for games.
reason: The previous define in sceUmd.cpp was 0x10 and the fix restores that value in this added line; the old value is only visible in the other file.

defect: FastLoadBoneMatrix dirties (DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << n) + 1 for the second matrix instead of the next flag bit, so the wrong uniform is dirtied and the next bone matrix is not updated.
reason: The fix uses DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << ((mtxNum + 1) & 7) instead; adding 1 to a bit flag is visible in the diff.

defect: auto framebuffers = framebufferManager_->Framebuffers() copies the framebuffer vector on every texture attach and CLUT load, causing slowdowns.
reason: The fix binds a const reference instead in these added lines; seeing the copy needs Framebuffers() returning a reference in the framebuffer manager.
